name: Insalata Pantesca
desc: Pantelleria potato salad with cherry tomatoes, salted capers, Taggiasca olives, red onion, oregano and basil.

source.title: Insalata Pantesca
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

steps: Put the whole, unpeeled potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, bring to a boil and cook about 30 min, until a fork slides in easily. Drain and let cool.
Meanwhile, soak the sliced onion in ice water for 10 min to soften its bite, then drain.
Rinse the capers well under running water to remove the salt.
Peel the cooled potatoes and cut them into large chunks.
In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, tomatoes, capers, olives and onion.
Season with the vinegar, olive oil, oregano, basil and salt, and toss gently.
Cover and let rest at least 10 min, or up to 1 hour, so the flavors come together before serving.
tips: The creator lists no olive oil or olive amount. These follow Italian home versions of the dish.
